page.layout: One page of text, two columns of running text in a single column at full width with a heavy rule dividing the upper table-like lists from the lower section; margin notes on the right side. Top: running head centred, page number at top right. Upper block: full-width list lines (Scripture references) with headings numbered 35, 36, 37 and their Roman numerals in the right margin. Rule. Lower block: heading LOCI MISCELLANEI with sub-headings 1 and 2, lists of references; margin notes right. Catchword/signature at the foot: "F 2" centred at the bottom.

page.notes: Left margin contains fragmentary show-through/edge text from the neighbouring page (marks such as "l.", "14.", "ll.", "9.", "20.", "5."), not transcribed. Several Roman-numeral and reference items in the right margin are printed with the section heads. Doubtful: "c.4." and "v.7." in the first Loci list, and the Greek-free references throughout were read from a low-contrast scan; the "&" between heading words is printed as "&". The "c." and "v." abbreviations are as printed in italic. The heavy rule between the upper and lower sections is a printed rule, not transcribed text.
